lessons.name: Estimate sums and differences: word problems

contents.text: Since he was hired, a chef has served 72 adults and 44 children. What is the total number of guests served? Choose the better estimate.
Since he was hired, a chef has served 72 adults and 44 children. What is the total number of guests served? Choose the better estimate.
Add the number of adults and the number of children.
Round each number to the nearest ten.

Mrs. Mercado's class raised two groups of silkworms. In one group, 59 silkworms turned into moths. In the other group, 36 silkworms turned into moths. In total, about how many silkworms turned into moths? Choose the better estimate.

Mrs. Mercado's class raised two groups of silkworms. In one group, 59 silkworms turned into moths. In the other group, 36 silkworms turned into moths. In total, about how many silkworms turned into moths? Choose the better estimate.
Add the numbers of silkworms that turned into moths.
Round each number to the nearest ten.

Emmett owns the Wafting Pie Company. This morning, his employees used 21 eggs to bake plum pies. If his employees used a total of 73 eggs today, about how many eggs did they use in the afternoon? Choose the better estimate.

Emmett owns the Wafting Pie Company. This morning, his employees used 21 eggs to bake plum pies. If his employees used a total of 73 eggs today, about how many eggs did they use in the afternoon? Choose the better estimate.
Subtract the number of eggs used in the morning from the total number of eggs.
Round each number to the nearest ten.

A wagon train on the Oregon Trail had 38 kilograms of meat in their covered wagon at the start of the week. After a week of unsuccessful hunting, they had 16 kilograms of meat. About how many kilograms of meat did they eat that week? Choose the better estimate.

A wagon train on the Oregon Trail had 38 kilograms of meat in their covered wagon at the start of the week. After a week of unsuccessful hunting, they had 16 kilograms of meat. About how many kilograms of meat did they eat that week? Choose the better estimate.
